🏠 Freehold, sectional title or estate: what's the difference?

🏡 Freehold: you own the house and the land. No levies, but you maintain everything.
🏢 Sectional title: you own your unit plus a share of common property. Monthly levies and body corporate rules.
🔒 Estate (HOA): freehold with an association. Levies pay for security and common areas, with building rules.

Always read the rules and the latest levy statement before you buy.
